newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB lifted by bad loan clean-up efforts in morning.
newsitem.headline: DKB lifted by bad loan clean-up efforts in morning.

text.p: Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd shares climbed on Monday morning despite a gloomy earnings forecast announced late last week, as investors welcomed the bank's efforts to solve its bad-loan problem.
At midday, its shares were up 10 yen at 1,300.
On Friday, the bank said it forecast a parent current loss of 300 billion yen, down from a previous forecast of a 40 billion yen profit in the 1996/97 business year.
The downward revision was due to efforts to dispose of problem loans worth 550 billion yen in the current year, it said.
